sentence: This project tests how a long-acting medication for HIV in pregnant women affects the immune system of mothers and their offspring in rhesus macaques.
This project studies how the ABL protein helps small cell lung cancer tumors grow, survive and spread.
This project builds neutralization assays and uses them on biobanked samples from a birth cohort to learn how natural humoral immunity to sapovirus works.
This project studies how variants change a voltage-gated potassium channel linked to developmental and epileptic encephalopathy.
This project tests whether Sirtuin-based drugs and immunotherapy can control tuberculosis and HIV infections at the same time.
This project builds computational tools that use deep learning to understand how protein sequences, structures and functions relate.
This project brings together cancer epidemiology cohorts to study how molecular subtype could guide prevention in men with prostate cancer.
This project studies how mucosal immunity to poliovirus develops and tests how an adjuvant changes immune responses to inactivated poliovirus vaccines.
This project studies how germline mutations, inflammation and secondary somatic mutations affect blood stem cells in myelodysplastic syndromes.
This project studies how mutations cause uterine fibroids by changing myometrial stem cell differentiation and causing replication stress.
This project studies how extrachromosomal DNA forms, works and helps cancer tumours resist treatment.
This project uses a probe adapted to the ear canal to find brain changes in people with tinnitus.
This project builds software tools that standardize ophthalmology datasets so they can be used for research and clinical care.
This project sets up a shared hub to manage and analyze epidemiologic and genomic data on multidrug resistant organisms in nursing homes.
This project uses functional ultrasound with electrophysiology to study how the primary motor cortex and posterior parietal cortex represent movement.
This project analyzes a large randomized study that compares two treatment schedules and studies genomic changes that predict how disease progresses.
This project studies how the malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum maintains protein homeostasis.
This project studies how people seek information about Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias using data science and social network analysis.
This project studies how atlastin GTPases shape the endoplasmic reticulum and how mutations lead to hereditary spastic paraplegia.
This project looks for inhibitors of an enzyme that bacteria need in order to grow.
